title: Cloud Security Engineer
description: Secure enterprise public cloud environments, automate Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM), enforce IAM least-privilege, and secure Kubernetes.

goal.objective: Architect, automate, and enforce zero trust security guardrails, data encryption, and identity protections across cloud infrastructure.

learn.summary: Master cloud IAM security policies, KMS encryption keys, Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM), container security, Kubernetes hardening, and cloud audit logging.
key_competencies: Cloud IAM Security, Permission Boundaries & SCPs
prerequisites: Cloud engineer fundamentals (AWS, Azure, or GCP)

capstone_projects.title: Automated Cloud Security Audit & Auto-Remediation Engine
capstone_projects.description: Deploy an automated cloud scanner that detects publicly open S3 buckets or unencrypted databases and automatically remediates them.

capstone_projects.title: Cloud Detection & Response (CDR) Honeynet on AWS/GCP
capstone_projects.description: Implement automated cloud incident response playbooks that isolate compromised EC2 instances, revoke active IAM credentials, and parse multi-cloud audit logs in real time.

certifications: Microsoft Certified: Azure Security Engineer Associate (AZ-500)
interview_focus: Preventing Privilege Escalation in Cloud IAM
Securing Secrets in Cloud Applications (Vault, AWS Secrets Manager)
Auditing Container Images in Private Registries
Responding to Compromised Cloud Access Keys

tree.name: Cloud and Cybersecurity Foundations
tree.description: Establish an uncompromised cloud security foundation: master cloud threat modeling, Linux systems security, and multi-cloud shared responsibility boundaries.

children.name: Cybersecurity Fundamentals
children.description: Master foundational information security principles: CIA triad, defense-in-depth, zero-trust network access (ZTNA), threat vectors, and modern cyber risk management frameworks (NIST CSF, MITRE ATT&CK for Cloud).

resources.title: CompTIA Security+ SY0-601 Full Course (Professor Messer)

children.name: Linux & Networking Essentials
children.description: Master operating system and network security for cloud infrastructure: iptables/nftables packet filtering, SSH key hardening, VPC routing, CIDR subnetting, TLS 1.3 protocol negotiation, and inspecting network sockets with `ss` and `tcpdump`.

children.name: Cloud Computing Fundamentals
children.description: Understand cloud architecture security implications: multi-tenancy risks, hypervisor isolation, cloud service abstractions (IaaS, PaaS, Serverless), and assessing compliance boundaries.

resources.title: Microsoft Azure Fundamentals AZ-900 Full Course (freeCodeCamp)

children.name: Cloud Shared Responsibility Model & Threat Modeling
children.description: Deconstruct the cloud Shared Responsibility Model: defining customer vs provider boundaries across compute and data tiers, and conducting cloud threat modeling using STRIDE and MITRE ATT&CK Cloud Matrix.

resources.title: Cloud Shared Responsibility Model Explained Simply
What is Threat Modeling? | Threat Modeling Fundamentals

tree.name: Cloud Platform Security Architecture
tree.description: Architect enterprise cloud defense: least-privilege identity governance, isolated network perimeters, and envelope encryption.

resources.title: What is Cloud Security? Crash Course

children.name: Cloud Identity & Access Management (IAM)
children.description: Master enterprise cloud identity architecture: least-privilege IAM policies, permission boundaries, Service Control Policies (SCPs) in AWS Organizations, Workload Identity Federation eliminating long-lived service account keys, temporary STS credentials, and session policy constraints.

resources.title: Azure Identity and Access Security Best Practices
IAM Explained in Google Cloud: Manage Access and Permissions

children.name: Cloud Network Security Design
children.description: Design zero-trust cloud network perimeters: Hub-and-Spoke architectures with centralized stateful firewalls (AWS Network Firewall, Azure Firewall), eliminating public IPs with PrivateLink and Private Endpoints, micro-segmentation with Security Groups, and Web Application Firewalls (AWS WAF, Cloud Armor).

resources.title: Managing security responsibilities for Amazon Virtual Private Cloud

children.name: Data Protection & Encryption in Cloud
children.description: Architect end-to-end cloud data protection: envelope encryption using Key Management Service (KMS) with Customer Managed Keys (CMKs), Hardware Security Modules (Cloud HSM), automatic key rotation, S3 Block Public Access, and TLS in transit.

resources.title: Data Protection in Cloud Computing - Cloud Security Tutorial

children.name: Platform-Specific Security Services & Tools
children.description: Master native cloud security tooling: AWS Security Hub and GuardDuty, Microsoft Defender for Cloud and Microsoft Sentinel, and Google Cloud Security Command Center (SCC).

resources.title: AWS GuardDuty Deep Dive | Protect your AWS Environment
Google Cloud Armor for Security Policy Management | Google Cloud

tree.name: Cloud Security Operations & Management
tree.description: Operate enterprise cloud security operations: posture management, entitlement analytics, SIEM telemetry, and automated digital forensics.

resources.title: AWS Security Best Practices (Amazon Web Services)

children.name: CSPM, CIEM, & Configuration Governance
children.description: Deploy Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) and Cloud Infrastructure Entitlement Management (CIEM): auditing configurations against CIS Benchmarks using Prowler, Steampipe, and Cloud Custodian; and eliminating dormant and over-privileged IAM permissions.

resources.title: What is Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM)? Simply Explained
What is Cloud Infrastructure Entitlement Management (CIEM)?

children.name: Cloud Logging, Monitoring & Threat Detection
children.description: Implement centralized cloud security logging: aggregating AWS CloudTrail, VPC Flow Logs, and DNS logs into immutable S3 buckets with Object Lock, authoring Athena SQL threat hunting queries, and detecting anomalous API activity.

resources.title: AWS Monitoring, Logging and Auditing with CloudWatch, CloudTrail, Config, GuardDuty & Inspector

children.name: Vulnerability Management & Patching
children.description: Manage cloud vulnerability lifecycles: continuous container and VM scanning with Amazon Inspector / Qualys / Nessus, prioritizing vulnerabilities based on EPSS and CVSS scores, and automating patch deployment.

resources.title: Vulnerability Management & Patching (from CompTIA Security+ Full Course)

children.name: Cloud Incident Response & Forensics
children.description: Lead cloud incident response and digital forensics: isolating compromised EC2/VM instances into quarantine security groups, snapshotting EBS volumes for offline forensics with Volatility and Autopsy, and analyzing CloudTrail API timelines.

resources.title: NIST SP 800-61 Rev. 2: Computer Security Incident Handling Guide
Cloud Incident Response: Best Practices & Strategies
AWS Incident Response: Best Practices for Cloud Security

tree.name: DevSecOps & Application Security in Cloud
tree.description: Embed security into cloud infrastructure and software pipelines: Infrastructure as Code security, container hardening, and serverless governance.

resources.title: A Complete DevSecOps Course | DevSecOps Training

children.name: Infrastructure as Code (IaC) Security
children.description: Enforce security policy as code: scanning Terraform and CloudFormation templates in CI pipelines with Checkov, tfsec, and Trivy; and blocking deployments containing public storage buckets, unencrypted disks, or wide-open security groups (0.0.0.0/0).

resources.title: Terraform Security Best Practices - The Ultimate Guide

children.name: Container & Kubernetes Security
children.description: Harden Kubernetes clusters: Pod Security Admission (Restricted profile), zero-trust NetworkPolicies, admission controllers (Kyverno, OPA Gatekeeper), and runtime syscall auditing with Falco.

resources.title: Cyber Security Full Course for Beginner

children.name: CI/CD Pipeline & Supply Chain Security
children.description: Harden CI/CD supply chain pipelines: securing GitHub Actions runners, generating Software Bill of Materials (SBOM), signing container images with Sigstore Cosign, and enforcing binary authorization before deployment.

resources.title: What is DevSecOps? Learn how to automate security in your CI/CD pipeline

children.name: API & Serverless Security
children.description: Secure serverless functions and APIs: restricting Lambda IAM execution roles to specific resources, securing API Gateways with custom authorizers and rate limiting, and mitigating serverless event injection.

resources.title: API Security Tutorial - Protecting RESTful APIs with JSON Web Tokens (JWT) and OAuth 2.0
The OWASP API Security Top 10 - Explained

tree.name: Governance, Risk, & Compliance (GRC) & Advanced Topics
tree.description: Govern enterprise risk and compliance: cloud architectural audits, regulatory frameworks, and emerging threat modeling.

resources.title: AWS Certified Security - Specialty Full Course
What is GRC? Governance, Risk and Compliance in Cybersecurity Explained

children.name: Cloud Governance, Risk Management & Compliance
children.description: Implement cloud governance and regulatory compliance: mapping cloud controls to SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, PCI-DSS, and HIPAA; and authoring automated compliance evidence collectors.

resources.title: Cloud Security Governance, Risk, and Compliance | Cloud Security Training | Simplilearn

children.name: Cloud Security Architecture Review & Design
children.description: Conduct rigorous Cloud Security Architecture Reviews: evaluating third-party SaaS integrations, assessing data flow boundaries, and enforcing the AWS Well-Architected Security Pillar.

resources.title: Cyber Security Full Course for Beginner

children.name: Emerging Cloud Security Technologies & Threats
children.description: Evaluate modern cloud attack vectors: supply-chain compromises, AI model data poisoning and prompt injection in cloud LLMs, and cloud identity federation takeover attacks.

resources.title: Gartner Top Security and Risk Management Trends
Cloud Security Trends to Watch Out For in 2024
What is Confidential Computing? | Google Cloud Tech

tree.name: Practical Application & Portfolio Building
tree.description: Build a hands-on cloud security portfolio: real-world IAM labs, automated security baselines, and cloud incident simulations.

resources.title: How to Build a Cyber Security Portfolio (Projects, Tips, Resume Advice)
AWS Certified Security - Specialty Full Course

children.name: Practice: IAM Policy Review & Remediation Lab
children.description: Hands-on Lab: audit complex IAM policies using AWS IAM Access Analyzer, identify cross-account escalation paths, and refactor policies into strictly bounded least-privilege definitions.

resources.title: AWS Certified Security - Specialty (SCS-C01) Full Course
AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate 2024 (SAA-C03) - Full Course

children.name: Project: Secure Cloud Baseline Deployment (Multi-Cloud)
children.description: Portfolio Project 1: Deploy an Automated Multi-Account Enterprise Security Baseline using Terraform: AWS Control Tower, centralized CloudTrail log archive, automated GuardDuty enablement across regions, and SCP guardrails.

resources.title: Cloud Security Fundamentals Course (AWS, Azure, GCP) - Full Tutorial
Zero Trust Architecture Explained For Beginners

children.name: Project: Secure DevSecOps Pipeline Implementation
children.description: Portfolio Project 2: Engineer an Automated DevSecOps Pipeline in GitHub Actions: Checkov IaC security scanning, Trivy container image scanning, Cosign cryptographic image signing, and Slack alerting.

resources.title: DevSecOps Tutorial - Build a Secure CI/CD Pipeline using Docker, Kubernetes & GitHub Actions

children.name: Project: Cloud Incident Response Simulation & Playbook
children.description: Portfolio Project 3: Conduct a Cloud Incident Response Game Day: simulate an unauthorized S3 exfiltration via stolen IAM credentials, execute automated remediation via EventBridge and Lambda, and author a post-incident analysis report.

resources.title: AWS Security Incident Response Guide: Playbooks
Cyber Security Full Course for Beginner

children.name: Certifications & Career Development
children.description: Prepare for industry credentials: AWS Certified Security - Specialty, Microsoft Certified: Azure Security Engineer Associate (AZ-500), or Google Cloud Professional Cloud Security Engineer; and master technical cloud security architecture interviews.

resources.title: AWS Certified Security - Specialty Exam Guide
Microsoft Certified: Azure Security Engineer Associate
Google Cloud Professional Cloud Security Engineer
Cyber Security Full Course for Beginner
